minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 15, 2021

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on November 15, 2021 at 9:00 am.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Raul Hernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Oscar Mayen DBA Live Nation Entertainment to host a Radio Promotion – Sneak
  Preview Event at 3900 W Manchester Blvd., on Monday, November 15, 2021, from
  2:00 p.m. – 6:30 p.m. Subject to Approval; Applicant to hire Adequate security
  Guards for safety of attendees and potential crowd control; Applicant must adhere
  to Code Enforcement Section 5-27 Base Ambient noise level Maintain site at all
  times ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of each day; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA
  County and CA State Health Department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  but not limited to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Unruh Civil Rights Act, and
  the California Disabled Persons Act. Motion and Seconded (Activity No. 00326800)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #2:  Marlon Lambert DBA Lambert Mini Mart to operate as a tobacco Retailer at 10719
  S. Prairie Ave; This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee: Must adhere to all
  City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8.
  REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO
  PRODUCTS; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
   regulations, including noise and signage; Sales or display of single cigarettes is
  strictly prohibited; All initial and renewal Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or
  new applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police or Code
  Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for
  Community Public Health & Safety; California State Board of Equalization Tobacco
  Retailers license must be current; NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to any Persons under 21 years of age; All persons purchasing tobacco or
  any related tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to
  ensure the restriction of underage tobacco use, including hookah products; Submit
  all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable; NO loitering of persons outside of
  the location; NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and
  visible to outside of the business. Proof of signage posted by applicant shall be
  submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); NO use or sales of any narcotics or
  narcotic paraphernalia. Example would be; any pipes used to ingest other narcotics
  such as base / “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine. This would also include any
  glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used to smoke /ingest narcotics. Sales
  of Tobacco or marijuana “bongs” or pipes are permitted. **Sales or display of ANY
  weapons (i.e.; clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser / stun guns, etc.)
  and Co2 canisters aka: “whippits”are STRICTLY PROHIBITED!**Applicant and
  employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police
  related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or
  response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning,
  Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); and The following is not allowed inside the
  business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, :NO LIVE BANDS /
  MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT
  MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF
  OPERATION. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00321010)

Item #3:  Levon Azizyan DBA Cali Smoke Shop to operate as a tobacco Retailer at 11050 S.
  Prairie Ave; This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
